@help.sections.0.items.0.name: Countries → Cities → Groups
@help.sections.0.items.0.text: Your organization is structured as Country → City → Group. Start with Countries and add the countries where you operate, then go to Cities to add cities under a country, then Groups for the groups members actually join. To add hundreds at once, use the bulk import on the Countries page instead of adding them one by one.
@help.sections.3.items.0.text: Create one-off or recurring events, for the whole organization or a specific group. Events start as drafts — click Publish (or "Publish series" for a recurring batch) when ready, or tick "Publish immediately" when creating.
@help.sections.3.items.5.text: Key figures: active members, pending approvals, groups and donations.

@help.sections.5.items.0.text: Create the levels (Level 1, Level 2…) under Academic levels. For each level, choose which other levels its groups can also access, and optionally cap how many library books can be assigned to it.
@help.sections.5.items.1.text: Every group, library book, academic material and equipment item has a level. Assign the group’s level on the Groups page, the book’s level in the Library, the material’s level in the Pedagogical committee, and the equipment’s level in Equipment. A group can only access items its level allows.
@help.sections.5.items.2.text: The equipment catalog lists every item with its level and quantity. Resource requests can only be made for items permitted by the requesting group’s level.
@hosts.intro: Everyone who holds the Host role in at least one group. To promote or demote someone from their full profile, use the Member management page — this page shows the same data from the other direction: you start from the Host, not the Member.
@hosts.assignHelp: Makes an existing member the Host of a group. They keep their other group memberships.
@hosts.removeFailed: Could not remove from the group
@levels.subtitle: Levels decide which library books, academic materials and equipment each group can access. Assign a level to every group, book, material and equipment item.
@levels.howItWorks: A group can access items of its own level, plus any other level you tick under "Also grants access to". A book limit caps how many library books can be assigned to a level. Rules are enforced on the server (Cloud Functions and Firestore security rules), not just hidden in this screen.
@levels.accessHelp: Groups at this level can also use items of the levels ticked here.
@levels.rebuildHelp: Each member’s accessible levels are recalculated automatically whenever groups, memberships or levels change. Use this after the first rollout of levels, or to repair the index.
